# 2018 Vuelta a Castilla y León

The 2018 Vuelta a Castilla y León was a stage race held in the Castilla y León region of Spain.

## Key Details

- **Date**: April 2018
- **Classification**: UCI Europe Tour race (2.1 category)
- **Format**: Multi-stage road cycling race

## Race Information

The race typically consists of several stages covering the autonomous community of Castilla y León in northwestern Spain. This event has been part of the Spanish cycling calendar for many years and attracts professional continental and some World Tour teams.

## Winner

**Jesús Herrada** (Cofidis) won the overall general classification.
